sources.title: A Concise Review of Hallucinations in LLMs and their Mitigation
sources.snippet: In choosing an LLM to reduce hallucinations: model architecture, quality and diversity of the training data, and strategies like fine-tuning or retrieval augmentation to alleviate hallucinations should be kept in mind.

sources.title: Mathematical Analysis of Hallucination Dynamics in Large Language ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful linguistic engines but remain susceptible to hallucinations—plausible-sounding outputs that are factually incorrect or unsupported. In this work, we present a coherent, mathematically grounded framework to understand, measure, and mitigate these hallucinations.
